Hotfix: on some setups the previous update crash-looped into a black screen. Just **force update** to pull the fix; your `/config` is untouched.

## Fixed
- **Black screen / crash loop after updating (`UnsupportedClassVersionError`).** A dependency bump compiled the container's dialog-agent (`jd-dialog-agent.jar`) with **Java 25**, but JDownloader itself runs on the **Java 21** runtime. The Java 21 JVM refused to load the newer agent class (`class file version 69.0`, this runtime only reads up to `65.0`), aborted the `-javaagent` at startup, and the autostart kept relaunching JDownloader into a black screen. The agent is now compiled with `javac --release 21`, so it always targets the runtime's Java version regardless of which JDK builds the image. If you're stuck on the black screen, a **force update** pulls the fixed image.

## Changed
- **CI can no longer let this slip through.** The image's smoke test used to pass the moment JDownloader's JVM *started* — but that log line prints just before a bad `-javaagent` would abort it, so the broken build went green. The gate now fails on JVM/agent crash signatures and on a relaunch loop, and requires the JVM to stay up before publishing, so a dialog-agent that can't load the runtime can never reach the published image again.
